map.5 位电传打字机码，含字母/数字模式切换。: A 5-bit teleprinter code with letter/figure mode switching.
map.早期电传打字机使用的 5 位字符编码，用换档控制字在字母与符号间切换。: The 5-bit character encoding used by early teleprinters, switching between letters and symbols with shift control codes.
map.：每字符 5 bit，共 32 种组合，不足以直接表示字母+数字+符号。: : 5 bits per character yields 32 combinations, not enough to represent letters, digits, and symbols directly.
map.：LTRS（字母档）与 FIGS（数字/符号档）控制字切换字符集，同一码在不同档: : the LTRS (letters) and FIGS (figures) control codes switch the character set, so the same code means different things in different shifts.
map.：Baudot 的国际改进版，是当前通行的 5 位电传码标准。: : the international improved version of Baudot and the prevailing 5-bit teleprinter standard today.
map.：起始位 + 5 数据位 + 停止位（常 1.5 或 2 位）；编码结果须显式输: : start bit + 5 data bits + stop bit (usually 1.5 or 2 bits); the encoded output must include the shift codes explicitly.
map.早期电传（TTY）5 位字符编码。: The 5-bit character encoding of early teleprinters (TTY).
map.业余无线电与电报爱好者做收发实验时，用 ITA2 把文字编成 5 位序列，理解早: Amateur radio and telegraph enthusiasts use ITA2 to encode text into 5-bit sequences for send/receive experiments, showing why early communication needed LTRS/FIGS shifts to extend the character set.
map.字母 A 在 ITA2 为 `00011`（含 Figure/Letter 切换: The letter A is `00011` in ITA2 (including the figure/letter shift bit).
map.仅 32 组合，需切换数字/字母档。: There are only 32 combinations, so figure/letter shifts are required.
map.为什么 5 位只能表示 32 个，却要传字母和数字？: Why can 5 bits represent only 32 values, yet still transmit both letters and digits?
map.因为用了换档：同一组 5 位码在字母档（LTRS）与符号档（FIGS）下含义不同: Because shifts are used: the same 5-bit code means different things in letter shift (LTRS) and figure shift (FIGS). The receiver must stay in the same shift as the sender; once a shift code is lost, everything after it is misinterpreted — a common cause of garbled output on early teleprinters.
map.Baudot/ITA2 编码。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏: Baudot / ITA2 Encode is an online tool built for developers. It runs entirely in your browser — your code never leaves it.
